Poor beyond poor service
Jan 2026 • Couples
This cafe bar goes by a different name at night ,Nori,which is primarily Japanese food
We were given a table by the door despite asking to sit inside due to the traffic pollution and people smoking outside
Waiter came for drinks order,brought the beers quite quickly but came without the little dish of nuts that other customers got
I had to ask him for the menu which he brought the Japanese one
I had to ask for the cafe menu as it was more to our taste 
We ordered spring rolls for starters and two mains 
After a wait of over 20 mins,my main plus the starters arrived when I asked why this had come out together the waiter said it’s the way the chef has cooked it !! I asked where my wife’s main dish was and was told it would be out in about five minutes !!
Bad service 
We ate as quick as possible in order to eat warm food but my wife’s lamb cutlets were pink in the muddle and one cutlet was completely fat and gristle 
When the bill came I was shocked to find that they had added 173000 dongs as service charge and tips 
I queried this with the waiter,then the cashier ,then the house manager got involved and he went to the manager with my complaint .the service was dire and did not warrant a tip ! He can back and told next he managed was unable to sort anything out and the bill stood
I payed up and left disgruntled

Singapore, Singapore10979 contributions

Nice ambience and drinks!
Sep 2023 • Family
It's good to be back to this cafe for our drinks since our last visit, prior to Covid19 pandemic in 2019.

The cafe had since undergone some renovation and we used to sit inside the cafe but they had already "scale down" and no longer have inside sitting and all outside. So we chose the more inside section (with fans) and sofa seats. It was comfortable though a little dark, beside to the bar. (We came by after having our dinner nearby)

The ambience was ok and like the background music.

Each of us ordered different drinks, like cappuccino, fruit juices, like lime, mango, mixed fruits, lime juices and mocktails. Staff were friendly but it took them quite a while for our drinks to be fully served (some came first, others came much later though we were the 2nd table of diners).

Overall, the drinks were nice and refreshing (as it was warm even at night time). Prices were reasonable and not exp at all. 

We enjoyed it!

Great location, average food
Mar 2023 • Family
Post the shopping spree at Ben Thanh, this was the closest restaurant we could find. With its prime location, assumed the food would be good too. 

To our disappointment, the food was average. Vegetable fried rice were particularly bad, had no taste. 

Service is pathetic. With only 2 tables occupied, we had to call the servers multiple times for anything we needed. And to top it, its priced on the bit expensive side only. 

Would say, give it a miss if possible. There are a lot of options in the vicinity.
